say.en: Polythene is made by joining thousands of ethene molecules. It is possible because the double bond in an alkene opens up and adds things across it. In this lesson: Describe the structure and geometrical isomerism of alkenes.
Prepare alkenes.
Predict products of addition by Markovnikov's rule, the peroxide effect and ozonolysis.

body.en: The C=C bond is one σ and one π bond (134 pm); the π bond stops free rotation, so alkenes like but-2-ene show cis–trans *isomerism*. cis-But-2-ene is polar and boils higher; the trans form is less polar and packs better. Alkenes are made by partial reduction of alkynes (Lindlar's catalyst gives cis, Na in liquid NH₃ gives trans), by dehydrohalogenation of alkyl halides with alcoholic KOH, by dehalogenation of vicinal dihalides with zinc, and by acidic dehydration of alcohols (ethanol with conc. H₂SO₄ at 443 K).
body.kn: C=C ಬಂಧ ಒಂದು σ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು π ಬಂಧ; π ಬಂಧ ಮುಕ್ತ ತಿರುಗುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಸಿಸ್–ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್ ಸಮಾವಯವತೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಲ್ಕೈನ್‌ಗಳ ಭಾಗಶಃ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಣ, ಆಲ್ಕೈಲ್ ಹ್ಯಾಲೈಡ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ, ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್‌ಗಳ ನಿರ್ಜಲೀಕರಣದಿಂದ ಆಲ್ಕೀನ್ ತಯಾರಿಕೆ.

title.en: Addition to alkenes: Markovnikov and beyond

say.en: Hydrogen bromide adds to propene. The proton can go to either end of the double bond, giving a secondary or a primary carbocation.
The more stable secondary carbocation forms, and bromide adds to it: 2-bromopropane. The negative part goes to the carbon with fewer hydrogens: Markovnikov's rule.
With a peroxide, HBr adds by a free-radical route and the result is reversed: 1-bromopropane. This peroxide effect works only for HBr.
Ozonolysis cuts the double bond into two carbonyl compounds. But-2-ene gives two molecules of ethanal; propene gives methanal and ethanal.
Addition to alkenes: Markovnikov and beyond.

passage.en: Ethanol heated with conc. H₂SO₄ at 443 K gives __1__. Propene adds HBr to give __2__ (Markovnikov's rule), but with a peroxide present it gives __3__. Red-brown bromine in CCl₄ is __4__ by an alkene. Cold dilute alkaline KMnO₄ (Baeyer's reagent) turns an alkene into a __5__. Ozonolysis of propene gives ethanal and __6__.

explanation.en: Markovnikov: the H of HX goes to the carbon that already has more H. Peroxide reverses this only for HBr. Baeyer's reagent and bromine water are tests for unsaturation.

say.en: Complete the summary of alkene reactions.

body.en: Alkenes add H₂, X₂, HX and H₂O across the double bond. With unsymmetrical reagents, Markovnikov's rule says the negative part adds to the carbon with fewer hydrogens, because the more stable carbocation forms: propene + HBr → 2-bromopropane. With HBr in the presence of peroxide, the *addition* is anti-Markovnikov (Kharash effect) and gives 1-bromopropane; this does not happen with HCl or HI. Ozonolysis cuts the C=C bond into two C=O compounds; cold dilute alkaline KMnO₄ (Baeyer's reagent) gives a diol and loses its pink colour.
body.kn: ಅಸಮಮಿತ ಕಾರಕಗಳ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರ್ಕೋವ್ನಿಕೋವ್ ನಿಯಮ: ಋಣ ಭಾಗ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಇರುವ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್‌ಗೆ. ಪೆರಾಕ್ಸೈಡ್ ಇದ್ದಾಗ HBr ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಓಝೋನೀಕರಣ C=C ಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Ethene is flat: all six atoms lie in one plane with angles near 120°. The π bond above and below this plane is why the molecule cannot twist. Try this: Look at ethene edge-on to see that it is flat, then explain why this rigidity allows cis–trans isomers.
caption.kn: ಈಥೀನ್ ಸಮತಟ್ಟಾಗಿದೆ: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಆರು ಪರಮಾಣುಗಳು ಸುಮಾರು 120° ಕೋನಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಸಮತಲದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಈ ಸಮತಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಳಗಿನ π ಬಂಧದಿಂದಾಗಿ ಅಣು ತಿರುಚಲಾರದು. ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ: ಈಥೀನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಅಂಚಿನಿಂದ ನೋಡಿ ಅದು ಸಮತಟ್ಟು ಎಂದು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಈ ಬಿಗಿತ ಸಿಸ್–ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್ ಸಮಾಂಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಏಕೆ ಅವಕಾಶ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

An sp carbon has 50% s character, so it holds electrons close and a terminal ≡C–H is weakly acidic: HC≡CH > CH₂=CH₂ > CH₃–CH₃. Terminal alkynes react with Na to give sodium acetylide and H₂, and give a white precipitate with ammoniacal AgNO₃ (Tollens' reagent).

problem.en: An alkene C₆H₁₂ on ozonolysis gives only propanone (2 mol per mol alkene). Identify it.

steps.en: Propanone is (CH₃)₂C=O, so each half of the alkene is (CH₃)₂C=.
Join the two halves at the double bond: (CH₃)₂C=C(CH₃)₂.

say.en: Let us solve this together. An alkene C 6H 12 on ozonolysis gives only propanone 2 moles per mol alkene. Identify it.
Propanone is CH 3 2C=O, so each half of the alkene is CH 3 2C=.
Join the two halves at the double bond: CH 3 2C=CCH 3 2.
Name: 2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene (C 6H 12 ✓).
So the answer is 2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Predict the major product of propene plus HBr, with and without benzoyl peroxide.
Without peroxide: H⁺ adds to C1, giving the more stable 2 degrees carbocation CH 3C⁺HCH 3; Br⁻ adds to C2 gives 2-bromopropane.
With peroxide: a Br• radical adds to C1 to form the more stable 2 degrees radical; the product is 1-bromopropane.
So the answer is 2-bromopropane no peroxide; 1-bromopropane with peroxide.

narration.en: Recap. The π bond prevents rotation, so some alkenes show cis–trans isomerism. Lindlar gives cis-alkenes; sodium in liquid ammonia gives trans. Markovnikov addition goes through the more stable carbocation; peroxide reverses it only for HBr. Ozonolysis splits C=C into two carbonyl compounds.
